meta.title: CV App Privacy Policy
meta.description: Privacy policy and data handling principles for CV App.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: We explain what data we collect, how we process it, and which controls are available to you so you can use CV App with confidence.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: You can update account and content settings at any time and limit how your data is used.

security.title: Security-first approach
security.body: Your data is protected with secure transport, access boundaries and row-level authorization policies.

transparency.title: Clear communication
transparency.body: We clearly state what we collect, why we collect it and how long it is retained.

dataCollect.title: Data We Collect
dataCollect.body: To provide the service, we process account details, resume content, basic session logs and technical error events. Additional data such as payment information is collected only when related features are enabled.

dataUse.title: How We Use Data
dataUse.body: Your data is used for resume creation, autosave, PDF export, ATS analysis display and account security operations. Marketing communication is sent only when you opt in.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.body: We process data under legal bases such as contract performance, legitimate interest and consent where required. You can withdraw consent in applicable cases.

retention.title: Retention Period
retention.body: Your content remains accessible while your account is active. After account closure requests, personal data is removed or anonymized within a reasonable period except where legal obligations require retention.

userControls.title: User Rights and Controls
userControls.body: You can update your profile, delete resumes and request data access or portability when needed. Session management options are provided for account safety.

security.title: Security Measures
security.body: Your data is protected on Supabase and PostgreSQL infrastructure. Access controls, encrypted transport and strict authorization rules ensure only account owners can access their content.

internationalTransfer.title: International Data Transfers
internationalTransfer.body: Because of infrastructure providers, data may be processed in different regions. Contractual and technical safeguards are applied whenever transfer scenarios occur.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy requests, data access inquiries or deletion requests, contact us at privacy@cvapp.com and we will respond as quickly as possible.

meta.title: CV App Terms of Service
meta.description: Terms of service and usage conditions for CV App.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: These terms describe your rights and responsibilities while using CV App. Continuing to use the service means you accept the latest version of these terms.

clarity.title: Clear rules
clarity.body: We define acceptable usage and explain when restrictions may be applied.

safety.title: Safe usage
safety.body: Rules are enforced to protect the platform and provide a reliable experience for all users.

fairAccess.title: Fair access
fairAccess.body: Rate limits and technical safeguards are used to maintain service stability.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using CV App, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.body: To use the service, you must create a valid account and provide accurate information. You are responsible for keeping account details current.

serviceScope.title: Service Scope
serviceScope.body: CV App provides resume creation, editing, analysis and export tools. Features may evolve over time as the product is improved.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: The service cannot be used for illegal activity, misleading content generation or violation of third-party rights. Access may be restricted when automated abuse is detected.

account.title: Account Responsibility
account.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and all activity under your account.

payments.title: Plans and Payments
payments.body: When paid plans are enabled, pricing, renewal and cancellation details are displayed during checkout. Payment operations may be handled by third-party providers.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.body: CV App interface, branding and software components are protected by intellectual property laws. Users remain responsible for the content they upload or create.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: CV App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for job application outcomes.

termination.title: Suspension and Termination
termination.body: Accounts may be suspended or terminated for policy violations, abuse or security risk scenarios.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the service means you accept the updated terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact us at support@cvapp.com.

meta.title: CV App Frequently Asked Questions
meta.description: Frequently asked questions and answers about CV App.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: We collected the most common questions to help you get started quickly. If you cannot find your answer, reach out to our support team.

free.question: Is CV App free to use?
free.answer: Yes. The free plan includes core editing features, allows up to 3 resumes and provides a limited number of PDF exports per month.

planLimits.question: What limits exist on the free plan?
planLimits.answer: The free plan includes limits such as resume count and monthly export quota. Current limits are always shown inside the product interface.

ats.question: What is ATS?
ats.answer: ATS is software used by companies to filter applications before human review. CV App helps structure your content to improve readability in ATS workflows.

pdfExport.question: How does PDF export work?
pdfExport.answer: PDF output reflects your latest editor content and view settings. If you hit a temporary connection issue, retrying shortly usually resolves it.

templates.question: Can I switch between templates?
templates.answer: Yes. You can switch between templates available in your current plan and quickly compare different visual styles for the same resume.

share.question: Can I share my resume publicly?
share.answer: Yes. You can share your resume with a public link and disable or regenerate that link later when needed.

ai.question: What are AI suggestions used for?
ai.answer: AI suggestions help improve clarity and impact in experience and project descriptions. Final content decisions always remain with the user.

dataSecurity.question: How secure is my data?
dataSecurity.answer: Your data is protected with access controls, secure session handling and infrastructure-level security measures. Other users cannot access your resume content.

deleteData.question: Can I delete my account and data?
deleteData.answer: Yes. You can submit account closure or data deletion requests through support channels. Data is removed except where legal obligations require retention.

pro.question: When will Pro be available?
pro.answer: Pro features will be released gradually. Updates are announced inside the app and through official communication channels.

billing.question: How will billing work when paid plans launch?
billing.answer: When paid plans are available, monthly or yearly options, renewal dates and cancellation rules will be clearly shown during checkout.

support.question: How can I contact support?
support.answer: For account, billing, privacy or technical issues, email support@cvapp.com. The team responds as quickly as possible based on request type.
